description: List a GitHub repository's commit history from https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/commits[/<branch>]. branch defaults to the repository's default branch. Returns commits with sha, message, author, author avatar, authored date, and commit URL. The page renders 35 commits per page; for a higher limit the command follows the page's Next pagination link (?after cursor) until the limit is reached or the history ends, and reports partial=true when the list is truncated. Reads the rendered commits page (SSR embedded data); no login required.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as owner/repo (e.g. facebook/react) or its full URL (e.g. https://github.com/facebook/react). Repository renames are followed via redirect (facebook/react -> react/react).（仓库标识：owner/repo 或完整 URL）

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch name (e.g. main, master). Defaults to the repository's default branch when omitted.（分支名，缺省用仓库默认分支）

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum commits to return (1-100, default 20). The first page renders 35; higher limits paginate via the Next link and partial=true is returned when the list is truncated by this limit.（条数上限，默认 20；首屏 35 条，超过则分页加载，partial 指示是否被截断）
